comments.title: 🔥豪赌预期与估值背离
comments.body: 市场处于预期与估值严重背离的阶段。场外巨鲸押注反弹至80000美元，但BTC价格仅报$64,279，甚至低于200日定投成本$70,635。现价距离成本线偏离-9.0%，筹码尚未全部获利，缺乏支撑反转的共识基础。偏空。谁在接盘豪赌？
comments.title_en: 🔥 High-Stakes Bet on Expectation vs. Valuation Divergence
comments.body_en: The market is currently in a phase of severe disconnect between expectations and valuation. OTC whales are betting on a rebound to $80,000, but BTC is trading at just $64,279—below the 200-day DCA cost basis of $70,635. The price sits -9.0% below the cost line, and not all chips are profitable yet. There is no consensus to support a reversal. Bearish. Who is absorbing this gamble?

comments.title: 🔥宏观风险压制盘面
comments.body: 市场处于宏观风险规避阶段。BMRI报75，处于RISK_OFF状态，确认当前流动性环境依然紧绷。BTC近7日下跌2.9%，显示资金在博弈降息前仍保持谨慎。若油价下跌重燃宽松预期，将是打破当前震荡的关键变量。当前定价权完全掌握在宏观手中。偏中性。宏观拐点何时出现？
comments.body_en: The market is in a macro risk-aversion phase. BMRI is at 75, signaling RISK_OFF and confirming that the liquidity environment remains tight. BTC has dropped 2.9% over the last 7 days, indicating capital is still cautious as it plays the rate cut game. If falling oil prices reignite easing expectations, that will be the key variable to break this current consolidation. Right now, pricing power is entirely in the hands of macro. Leaning neutral. When will the macro inflection point arrive?

comments.title: 🔥资金结构未现轮动信号
comments.body: 市场处于资金结构紧缩状态。BTC.D 为 58.4%，7 日仅变化 -0.5%，同期 BTC 价格却下跌 2.6%。价格跌幅远超主导地位降幅，意味着山寨币跌幅更深，存量资金并未从 BTC 向外轮动。市场缺乏补涨动力，流动性正在收缩。偏空。流动性拐点在何方？
comments.body_en: The market is in a state of capital contraction. BTC.D is at 58.4%, shifting just -0.5% over the last 7 days, while BTC price fell 2.6% in the same period. The price drop significantly outpaces the decline in dominance, meaning alts have bled even harder. Capital is not rotating out of BTC. The market lacks catch-up momentum, and liquidity is shrinking. Bearish. Where is the liquidity inflection point?

comments.title: 🔥周期估值底已显著抬升
comments.body: 市场处于长线筑底周期。MVRV报1.23，高于上轮同期（2022-09）的0.92。虽然现价较200日定投成本偏离-11.8%，但估值底并未跌回前轮深渊。这说明长线筹码支撑更强，市场底位正在抬高。当前优于历史79%的时间，具备极高的定投盈亏比。偏多。反转信号何时确立？
comments.title_en: 🔥 The Cycle Valuation Floor Has Clearly Lifted
comments.body_en: The market is in a long-term bottoming phase. MVRV sits at 1.23, higher than the 0.92 recorded at this point in the last cycle (Sept '22). Despite current price trading -11.8% below the 200-day DCA cost, the valuation floor hasn't retraced to the abyss of the previous cycle. This signals stronger support from long-term holders—the market base is rising. Current metrics are better than 79% of history, offering an exceptional risk-reward ratio for DCA. Bullish bias. When will the reversal signal be confirmed?

comments.title: 🔥链上指标确认极值底部
comments.body: 市场处于深度价值筑底区。AHR999(3D版)为0.35，处于抄底区间，显示长线定投安全边际极高。MVRV报1.21，低于历史80%的时间，说明市场获利盘极度匮乏。价格较200日定投成本偏离-9.5%，仍在低位震荡清洗筹码。数据层面已进入高性价比区间。偏多。底部还磨多久？
comments.body_en:
The market is sitting in a deep value accumulation zone. AHR999 (3D) is at 0.35—firmly in the buy-the-dip range—signaling an extremely high safety margin for long-term DCA. MVRV sits at 1.21, below 80% of historical levels, indicating an extreme scarcity of profitable positions. Price is -9.5% below the 200-day DCA cost, still oscillating at lows to shake out weak hands. From a data standpoint, we’ve entered a high-value territory.
Bias: Bullish.
How much longer will this bottom grind drag on?

comments.title: 🔥宏观指标处于避险压制区
comments.body: 市场正面临宏观流动性紧缩周期。BMRI数值为74，处于RISK_OFF区间，显示资金风险偏好极低。结合当前市场等待油价下跌重燃降息预期的现状，该指标确认了外部环境并未改善，存量资金在避险情绪主导下难以推动资产趋势反转。偏空。宏观宽松何时来临？
comments.body_en: The market is facing a macro liquidity tightening cycle. BMRI is at 74, sitting in the RISK_OFF zone, signaling extremely low risk appetite. With the market waiting for oil prices to drop to reignite rate cut expectations, this indicator confirms the external environment hasn't improved. Existing capital, dominated by risk-averse sentiment, cannot drive an asset trend reversal. Bearish. When will macro easing arrive?

comments.title: 🔥巨鲸逆势博弈极端反转
comments.body: 市场处于多空剧烈分歧期。BTC价格7日下跌4.1%至$63,872，现货疲软，但场外资金却在博弈极端反转。巨鲸与期权交易员正押注BTC反弹至80000美元，试图捕捉供应紧缩带来的红利。这种远期看涨与即期下跌的背离，暗示主力资金正在为下一轮趋势建仓。偏多。现货何时跟上？

comments.title: 🔥市场结构显示同步流动性外流
comments.body: 市场处于全面普跌状态。BTC.D指标为58.6%，7日变化为-0.0%。在BTC价格本周下跌3.2%的背景下，BTC.D维持恒定，说明场内并未发生“币种轮动”避险，而是比特币与山寨币同步面临流动性枯竭。资金正在撤离整个板块。偏空。避险资金去哪了？
comments.body_en: The market is facing a broad sell-off. BTC.D is sitting at 58.6%, with a 7-day change of -0.0%. With BTC down 3.2% this week, the stable dominance indicates that there is no "rotation" into safety. It’s not capital shifting within the market; rather, both Bitcoin and altcoins are facing a simultaneous liquidity drain. Capital is exiting the entire sector. Bearish. Where is the flight to safety heading?

comments.title: 🔥周期估值处于历史极寒区
comments.body: 市场处于历史大底区域。MVRV读数1.22，低于历史79%的时间，且逼近上轮同期2022-08的1.03。这种极低分位显示资产被严重低估，市场筹码已在此位置完成深度清洗。历史数据表明，当前区间往往是长周期行情的孕育起点。偏多。周期钟摆何时回弹？
comments.title_en: 🔥Cycle Valuations in a Historic Deep Freeze
comments.body_en: The market is currently sitting in a major historical bottom zone. The MVRV reading sits at 1.22—below 79% of historical levels and closing in on the 1.03 mark from the same period in the last cycle (Aug 2022). This extreme percentile signals severe undervaluation, indicating that a deep market washout has already occurred at these levels. History shows that this range is often the incubation point for long-term trends. Leaning Bullish. When will the cycle pendulum swing back?

comments.title: 🔥价格大幅偏离持有成本
comments.body: 市场处于深度贴水筑底期。当前价格 $64,469 显著低于 200日定投成本 $72,105，偏离度达 -10.6%。这表明近半年的平均买入者已全线浮亏，上方密集的套牢盘将压制反弹空间。只有价格重新站上成本线，才能确认右侧信号。中性。谁在成本线下吸筹？
comments.title_en: 🔥 Price Massively Diverges from Holding Cost
comments.body_en: The market is deep in a discount bottoming phase. Current price at $64,469 is significantly below the 200-day DCA cost of $72,105, a deviation of -10.6%. This implies the average buyer over the last six months is universally underwater, and the dense trapped supply overhead will cap any rebound. Only a reclaim of the cost line confirms the right-side signal. Neutral. Who is accumulating below the cost line?

comments.title: 🔥宏观环境处于风险关闭
comments.body: 市场处于宏观压制期。BMRI指标读数为73，处于RISK_OFF区间，说明当前美元流动性环境不支持风险资产大幅扩张。虽然油价下跌引发降息押注，但该指标显示宏观紧缩实际影响犹在。AHR999仅为0.34的低位信号，需等待流动性拐点确认。中性。降息博弈还能持续吗？
comments.body_en: The market is under macro suppression. The BMRI indicator sits at 73, deep in the RISK_OFF zone, signaling that current USD liquidity conditions can't support a major expansion in risk assets. Even though falling oil prices have sparked rate cut bets, this indicator shows the actual drag of macro tightening is still very real. AHR999 is flashing lows at just 0.34—we need to wait for confirmation of a liquidity inflection point. Neutral. Can the rate cut game last much longer?

comments.title: 🔥BTC.D走高揭示避险逻辑
comments.body: 市场处于存量资金避险阶段。BTC.D 报 58.9%，7 日变化 +0.9%。在价格小幅反弹背景下，dominance 逆势拉升，表明资金正从山寨币撤出回流比特币。流动性向头部资产集中反映了风险偏好极低，场内结构不支持普涨行情。中性。山寨季还有希望吗？
comments.body_en: The market is currently in a risk-off phase, trading on existing liquidity. BTC.D sits at 58.9%, up 0.9% over the last 7 days. Despite a slight price rebound, dominance is bucking the trend—this signals capital is rotating out of altcoins and flowing back into BTC. Liquidity concentrating in top-tier assets reflects extremely low risk appetite, and the current market structure simply doesn't support a broad rally. Neutral. Is there any hope left for altseason?

comments.title: 🔥估值底强于上轮同期
comments.body: 市场处于历史周期筑底期。MVRV 指标报 1.26，尽管仍处于低于历史 77% 时间的低位，但数值已高于上轮周期同期的 1.03。这种跨周期对比证实，当前市场的估值底比 2022 年更为坚实，筹码结构未进一步恶化。底部具备强支撑。偏多。周期拐点还有多远？
comments.title_en: 🔥Valuation floor is stronger than the last cycle
comments.body_en: The market is in a historical bottoming phase. MVRV sits at 1.26. While still low—lower than 77% of historical readings—it’s already above the 1.03 from the same stage of the last cycle. This cross-cycle comparison confirms that the current valuation floor is more solid than in 2022, and the supply structure hasn't deteriorated further. Strong support at the bottom. Leaning bullish. How far are we from the cycle inflection point?

comments.title: 🔥负乖离确认定投价值
comments.body: 市场处于深度定投区。当前价格 $66,597 低于 200 日定投成本 $72,694，负向偏离达 -8.4%。这意味着长期持有者成本高于现价，浮亏筹码锁定良好，抛压已衰竭。配合 AHR999 为 0.37，估值底部信号明确。偏多。跌破均线是机会吗？

comments.title: 🔥Risk_off下的资产背离
comments.body: 市场处于宏观风险规避期。BMRI 指数仅为 75（RISK_OFF），表明大环境风险偏好极低。但 BTC 价格逆势上涨 4.9% 至 $65,490，与宏观情绪背离，证明当前抛压已极度衰竭。估值底部支撑对抗宏观逆风，变盘仅缺流动性信号。中性。宏观转机何时出现？
comments.body_en: The market is in a macro risk-aversion phase. The BMRI index sits at a mere 75 (RISK_OFF), signaling extremely low risk appetite in the broader environment. However, BTC defied the odds, rallying 4.9% to $65,490. This divergence from macro sentiment proves that sell-side pressure is completely exhausted. Valuation bottoms are holding up against macro headwinds; a pivot is just missing the liquidity signal. Neutral. When will the macro shift hit?

comments.title: 🔥资金回流比特币避险
comments.body: 市场结构呈二八分化。BTC.D 为 58.7%，且 7 日变化达 +0.3%。在 BTC 价格仅微涨的背景下，主导率逆势上扬，说明资金正在加速从其他资产抽离并回流比特币。存量资金被 BTC 吸纳，市场难以走出普涨行情。中性。你还在持有弱势币吗？
comments.title_en: 🔥 Capital Rotates Back to BTC as a Safe Haven
comments.body_en: Market structure is showing a clear divergence. BTC.D stands at 58.7%, with a 7-day change of +0.3%. With BTC price barely moving, dominance is bucking the trend—this indicates capital is accelerating its rotation out of other assets and flowing back into Bitcoin. Liquidity is being absorbed by BTC, so a broad market rally is unlikely. Neutral. Still holding weak coins?

comments.title: 🔥周期底部强于上轮
comments.body: 市场处于相对强势的周期底部。对比上轮同期（2022-08），MVRV 为 1.21，显著高于当时的 1.03。这显示虽然 AHR999 同处于 0.35 的抄底区，但筹码并未陷入全面亏损的绝境。这种“强底”特征意味着当前更大概率是时间换空间，而非深度暴跌。变盘在即吗？
comments.body_en: The market is holding a relatively strong cycle bottom. Compared to the same period last cycle (Aug '22), MVRV sits at 1.21, significantly higher than the 1.03 back then. This shows that while AHR999 is also in the 0.35 buy zone, chips haven't fallen into a state of total loss. This "strong bottom" dynamic implies a higher probability of trading time for space, rather than a deep crash. Is a pivot imminent?

comments.title: 🔥价格击穿长线平均持仓成本
comments.body: 市场处于深度低估区。AHR999(3D)仅0.34，确认位于抄底区间。当前价格$63,852已大幅低于200日定投成本$73,159，偏离度-12.7%。这意味着长线筹码平均持仓已被击穿，下行空间极其有限，当前盈亏比极具优势。偏多。敢不敢做时间的朋友？
comments.body_en: Market is in deep undervalued territory. AHR999 (3D) is just 0.34, confirming we're in the accumulation zone. Current price ($63,852) is significantly below the 200-day DCA cost ($73,159), a -12.7% deviation. This means long-term holder cost basis has been breached. Downside is extremely limited, and the risk-reward is highly favorable. Bullish. Do you have the guts to befriend time?

comments.title: 🔥宏观指标维持避险信号
comments.body: 市场处于流动性紧缩期。BMRI 为 78，处于 RISK_OFF 状态，显示宏观环境仍被避险情绪主导。尽管价格企稳于 $63,834，但缺乏增量流动性支持，风险偏好持续受压，突破缺乏宏观动力。中性。全球流动性何时转向？
comments.body_en: The market is in a liquidity tightening period. BMRI sits at 78, in a RISK_OFF state, signaling that the macro environment is still dominated by risk-off sentiment. Although price has stabilized at $63,834, the lack of incremental liquidity support keeps risk appetite suppressed. A breakout lacks macro momentum. Neutral. When will global liquidity pivot?

comments.title: 🔥资金极致向头部汇聚
comments.body: 市场处于结构收缩期。BTC.D 达 58.5%，7日涨幅 1.0%。资金并未随价格反弹扩散至山寨币，反而加速向头部资产回流。这种明显的“吸血效应”显示存量资金风险偏好极低，仅抱团高流动性资产。缺乏板块轮动信号，短期难言行情反转。中性。场外增量资金何时入场破局？
comments.title_en: 🔥 Capital is Aggressively Rotating into Top-Tier Assets
comments.body_en: The market is in a phase of structural contraction. BTC.D sits at 58.5%, up 1.0% over the last 7 days. Liquidity isn't spilling over into altcoins despite the price bounce; instead, it's accelerating back into major assets. This pronounced "liquidity vacuum" reveals that existing capital has extremely low risk appetite, preferring to crowd into high-liquidity plays. Without signs of sector rotation, a short-term trend reversal is unlikely. Neutral. The key question: when will fresh off-chain capital step in to break the stalemate?

comments.title: 🔥当前周期复刻22年底部
comments.body: 市场处于深度熊市筑底期。MVRV 为 1.19，仅略高于 2022-08 同期的 1.03，且低于历史 80% 的时间。估值水平与上一轮周期末段高度重合，显示筹码在低位充分沉淀，但缺乏增量驱动，短期难改磨底趋势。偏多。至暗时刻还剩多久？
comments.body_en: The market is deep in a bear market bottoming phase. MVRV sits at 1.19, just slightly above the 1.03 from the same period in Aug '22, and lower than 80% of historical levels. Valuations are heavily overlapping with the tail end of the last cycle, showing chips are fully settling at the lows. But lacking incremental drivers, the grinding bottom trend is unlikely to break short-term. Leaning bullish. How much longer until the darkest hour passes?

comments.title: 🔥价格倒挂200日成本15%
comments.body: 市场处于极具赔率的定投舒适区。当前价格 $63,012 低于 200日定投成本 $74,101，倒挂幅度达 -15.0%。新入场资金成本已优于过去半年平均水平，且 AHR999(3D) 为 0.33 处于抄底区。持仓成本下移构筑了坚实底部。偏多。谁在交出底部带血筹码？
comments.body_en: The market is in a prime DCA zone with insane risk/reward. Current price ($63,012) is trading 15.0% below the 200-day DCA average ($74,101). New entries are better than the 6-month average, and AHR999 (3D) sits at 0.33—deep in accumulation territory. Lowering cost basis is constructing a solid floor. Bias: Bullish. Who is capitulating at the bottom?

comments.title: 🔥宏观流动性处于防御模式
comments.body: 市场处于宏观风险防御期。BMRI 指数为 75，处于 RISK_OFF 区间，意味着资金避险情绪浓厚且增量匮乏。当前资产定价高度依赖流动性，若油价下跌引发降息预期升温，将有效改善估值环境。中性。宏观拐点何时确立？
comments.body_en: The market is in a defensive phase against macro risks. The BMRI is at 75, sitting in the RISK_OFF zone, signaling heavy risk aversion and a scarcity of fresh capital. Asset pricing is currently highly dependent on liquidity. If falling oil prices ignite rate cut expectations, it would effectively improve the valuation environment. Neutral. When will the macro inflection point be confirmed?

comments.title: 🔥资金回流BTC避险主导
comments.body: 市场结构处于深度防御状态。BTC.D为58.1%，7日变化+0.2%。在BTC价格7日下跌10%的背景下，市值占比反而微升，证实资金正从山寨币抽离回流至大饼避险。当前仅为存量资金的防御性轮动，并无增量入场信号。中性。流动性枯竭何时结束？
comments.title_en: 🔥 Capital Rotation to BTC Dominates Risk-Off Play
comments.body_en: Market structure is in deep defensive mode. BTC.D sits at 58.1%, with a 7-day change of +0.2%. Despite a 10% drop in BTC price over the last week, its dominance has actually inched up. This confirms capital is fleeing altcoins and rotating back into BTC for safety. Currently, this is purely defensive rotation of existing capital—there are no signals of fresh inflows. Neutral. When will the liquidity crunch end?

comments.title: 🔥周期估值对标上轮大底
comments.body: 市场处于深度磨底期。MVRV 为 1.19，低于历史 81% 的时间。对比上轮周期同期（2022-08）的 1.03，当前估值水平已极度接近上一轮熊市末期，意味着筹码结构已出清完毕，具备极高的长期配置价值。偏多。黎明前的黑暗还有多长？
comments.title_en: 🔥 Cycle Valuation Matching the Last Macro Bottom
comments.body_en: We are deep in the bottoming grind. MVRV sits at 1.19, lower than 81% of historical data. Compared to 1.03 in the last cycle (Aug 2022), current valuations are dangerously close to the final stages of the previous bear market. This implies the supply structure has been fully flushed, offering massive long-term value. Bullish bias. How much longer is the darkness before dawn?

comments.title: 🔥周期指标回归历史大底
comments.body: 市场处于深度筑底阶段。AHR999 (3D版) 为 0.32，处于抄底区。该数值持平于历史数据中 2022-12 的月均值 0.32，意味着当前周期位置回归至与上一轮熊市末期相同的极低水位，定投性价比极高。偏多。变盘节点何时出现？
comments.body_en: Market is deep in the accumulation phase. The AHR999 (3D) sits at 0.32—firmly in the buy zone. This metric mirrors the monthly average from Dec 2022, signaling that we’ve returned to the same extreme lows seen at the end of the last bear market. The risk/reward for DCAing here is exceptional. Bullish bias. But when will the reversal trigger?

comments.title: 🔥宏观流动性极度紧缩
comments.body: 市场陷入深度防御模式。BMRI 报 71，处于 RISK_OFF 区间，证实当前宏观环境下风险偏好极低。流动性紧缩导致避险情绪升温，资金不愿介入高波动资产，定价权完全受制于外部宏观变量。中性。降息交易何时启动？
comments.body_en:
Markets are in deep defense mode. BMRI prints 71, sitting firmly in the RISK_OFF zone, confirming that risk appetite is practically non-existent in this macro environment. The liquidity squeeze is fueling risk-off sentiment—capital is shunning high-volatility assets, and price action is entirely dictated by external macro variables.
Neutral.

Is it time for left-side entry?

comments.title: 🔥宏观紧缩限制上涨高度
comments.body: 市场受制于宏观流动性紧缩。BMRI 指标录得 78，处于 RISK_OFF 区域，显示资金风险偏好低迷。尽管 BTC 价格回升至 $81,018，但在宏观风险警报解除前，资金入场意愿不足，上涨动能难以持续。大级别反弹仍需等待宏观配合。中性。流动性拐点何时出现？

comments.title: 🔥吸血效应强化避险逻辑
comments.body: 市场呈现极端的结构性分化。BTC.D升至60.6%，7日增幅1.1%，在价格反弹5.9%的同时主导率不降反升。这证明本轮上涨并非由流动性普涨驱动，而是资金从山寨币撤离并涌入比特币的避险行为。存量博弈下，大币种吸干流动性导致市场缺乏做多合力。中性。存量博弈下山寨还有生机吗？

comments.title: 🔥本轮估值显著高于同期
comments.body: 市场处于结构性磨底期。MVRV 报 1.45，虽低于历史 62% 的时间，但较上轮周期同期（2022-06）的 1.05 高出 38%。这意味着本轮牛熊转换的底部支撑位已大幅抬升，并未出现历史极端低估的恐慌定价。中性。底部抬高是否意味着下跌空间有限？
comments.title_en: 🔥 Current valuations are significantly higher than the same period last cycle
comments.body_en: The market is in a structural bottoming phase. MVRV sits at 1.45. While lower than 62% of historical readings, it’s 38% higher than the same point in the last cycle (June 2022). This implies the support floor for this cycle's transition has been significantly elevated; we aren't seeing the panic pricing typical of historical extreme undervaluations. Neutral. Does a higher floor mean limited downside?

comments.title: 🔥指标触及定投黄金坑
comments.body: 市场深陷低估区域。AHR999(3D)报0.48处于定投区，当前价格$78,483低于200日定投成本$83,535，偏离-6.0%。这意味着市场平均持币成本被击穿，浮筹已大幅出清。低于长期成本的定价通常对应极高的安全边际与盈亏比。偏多。左侧机会确认了吗？
comments.body_en: Market is deep in undervalued territory. AHR999 (3D) is at 0.48, sitting right in the accumulation zone. Current price of $78,483 is below the 200-day DCA cost of $83,535, a -6.0% deviation. This means the average market cost basis has been broken through, and weak hands have been largely flushed out. Pricing below long-term cost typically correlates with massive safety margins and risk-reward ratios. Bullish. Is the left-side play confirmed?

comments.title: 🔥流动性修复助推反弹
comments.body: 宏观环境处于流动性修复期。BMRI 数值回升至 78，显著超越 4 月均值 61.32。虽然仍处于 RISK_OFF 状态，但金融条件的边际宽松支撑了 BTC 价格 7 日 2.3% 的涨幅。数据表明，当前反弹动力源于外部宏观预期改善，而非内部资金涌入。偏多。美联储转向是否在即？
comments.body_en: The macro environment is currently in a liquidity repair phase. BMRI has rebounded to 78, significantly outpacing April's average of 61.32. While we remain in RISK_OFF mode, the marginal easing of financial conditions has underpinned BTC’s 7-day gain of 2.3%. Data indicates that current momentum stems from improved external macro expectations rather than internal capital inflows. Leaning bullish. Is the Fed pivot imminent?

comments.title: 🔥资金避险推动吸血行情
comments.body: 市场呈现结构性分化。BTC.D 回升至 60.1%，7 日增长 1.5%，显示资金在反弹中优先拥抱比特币，避险属性强化。当前价格 $78,347 的上涨主要由比特币主导，而非流动性普溢。存量博弈下，山寨币流动性被进一步挤压。行情是反弹还是反转？

comments.title: 🔥周期定位复刻历史底
comments.body: 市场处于周期底部磨底阶段。MVRV 为 1.40，对比上轮周期同期（2022-05）的 1.32，当前估值定位极其接近历史大底。虽价格 7 日回升 2.4%，但仍偏离 200 日定投成本 -11.1%。数据表明市场处于绝望期尾部，具备极高的盈亏比。偏多。黎明前的黑暗还有多久？
comments.body_en: The market is currently grinding at the cycle bottom. MVRV sits at 1.40; compared to 1.32 during the same period of the last cycle (May '22), current valuation is tracking extremely close to the historical macro bottom. Despite a 2.4% 7-day rebound, price is still trading -11.1% below the 200-day DCA cost basis. Data suggests we are at the tail end of the despair phase, offering an asymmetric risk/reward setup. Bullish bias. How much longer before the dawn breaks?

comments.title: 🔥深度低估引发估值修复
comments.body: 市场处于低估修复期。MVRV 为 1.36，数值低于历史上 68% 的时间，且对比 2022 年 5 月的 1.32 优势微弱。当前价格 76,069 美元距 200 日定投成本 86,103 美元仍有 11.7% 的负偏离。这意味着长期持筹者普遍处于浮亏状态，抛压枯竭。偏多。距离回归成本线还有多远？
comments.body_en: The market is in a valuation recovery phase. MVRV sits at 1.36, lower than 68% of historical data, with only a slight edge over the 1.32 seen in May 2022. At $76,069, price remains 11.7% below the 200-day DCA cost basis of $86,103. This implies that long-term holders are largely underwater, leaving sell-side pressure exhausted. Leaning Bullish. How far until we reclaim the cost basis?

comments.title: 🔥宏观风险压制反弹高度
comments.body: 市场处于筑底修复期。BMRI 读数 78（RISK_OFF），表明宏观流动性环境未改善。受油价下跌影响，BTC 价格 7 日回升 4.4% 至 74,347 美元，但仍处于 200 日定投成本 86,327 美元下方，偏离达 13.9%。资金在强阻力区前依然谨慎。降息预期是否已过度交易？
comments.body_en: The market is in a bottoming and repair phase. BMRI sits at 78 (RISK_OFF), signaling that macro liquidity conditions haven't improved. BTC rebounded 4.4% over the last 7 days to $74,347, helped by falling oil prices, but it still trades 13.9% below the 200-day DCA cost of $86,327. Capital remains cautious ahead of strong resistance. Have rate cut expectations been over-traded?

comments.title: 🔥存量博弈，BTC主导格局未变
comments.body: 市场处于典型的存量博弈阶段，资金结构向比特币倾斜。BTC.D 数据录得 59.2%，7 日变化为 +0.5%。尽管近期价格波动，但持续处于 59% 上方的指标意味着资金并未流向山寨币，市场流动性依旧紧缩并集中于头部资产。这种结构下，山寨币难以启动独立行情。资金外溢信号何时出现？
comments.title_en: 🔥 Zero-sum game, BTC dominance remains unchanged
comments.body_en: The market is in a typical zero-sum game phase, with capital structure tilting towards Bitcoin. BTC.D sits at 59.2%, with a 7-day change of +0.5%. Despite recent volatility, the indicator holding above 59% means capital is not flowing into altcoins; market liquidity remains tight and concentrated in top-tier assets. Under this structure, altcoins struggle to launch independent rallies. When will the capital spillover signal appear?

comments.title: 🔥周期坐标重演22年深熊
comments.body: 市场处于深度熊市筑底期。AHR999(3D)报0.45，精准对应2022年6月均值0.44的历史极值。尽管指标7日反弹13.1%，但当前所处的时间节点与上轮周期底部高度重合。数据证实市场已完成深度出清，周期反转只需耐心等待。谁能熬过最后的至暗时刻？
comments.title_en: 🔥Cyclical Coordinates Reenact the '22 Deep Bear Market
comments.body_en: The market is in the deep bear market bottoming phase. AHR999 (3D) sits at 0.45, precisely matching the historical extreme of 0.44 from June 2022. Despite a 13.1% 7-day rebound, the current timeline heavily overlaps with the previous cycle's bottom. Data confirms the market flush is complete; the cycle reversal just requires patience. Who can survive the final darkest hour?

comments.title: 🔥周期估值回撤至22年深渊
comments.body: 市场处于周期性底部磨底阶段。MVRV读数为1.37，与2022年5月同期的1.32高度趋同，且低于历史上68%的时间。数据显示当前筹码估值已回归至上轮熊市的极寒区域，市场整体处于深度亏损状态。周期底部的确定性正在增加，耐心等待流动性转向。这是否意味着长线买点已现？

comments.title: 🔥宏观风险压制反弹空间
comments.body: 市场受宏观流动性压制，处于弱势筑底阶段。BMRI指标读数为73，深陷RISK_OFF区间，表明资金风险偏好极低。尽管BTC周内反弹5.8%，但若无外部流动性注入，涨势难以为继。当前走势高度依赖油价表现，只有降息预期重燃，才能打开上行空间。短期维持中性。美联储会转向吗？
comments.body_en: The market is weighed down by macro liquidity, stuck in a weak bottoming process. BMRI reads 73, deep in the RISK_OFF zone, signaling rock-bottom risk appetite. Despite BTC's 5.8% weekly bounce, this rally is unsustainable without an external liquidity injection. Price action is currently tied to oil; we won't see meaningful upside until rate cut expectations reignite. Neutral stance in the short term. Will the Fed pivot?

comments.title: 🔥存量资金加速回流大饼
comments.body: 市场处于流动性虹吸状态。BTC.D触及59.1%，7日激增1.9%。尽管BTC价格较200日成本倒挂16.9%，但资金选择逃离山寨币而非抄底。数据显示，这并非增量资金推动的普涨，而是存量博弈下的避险轮动。山寨币正在失血，市场极度厌恶风险。这种二八分化还要持续多久？
comments.title_en: 🔥 Liquidity is aggressively rotating back into BTC
comments.body_en: The market is caught in a liquidity siphon. BTC.D hit 59.1%, surging 1.9% in just 7 days. Despite BTC trading at a 16.9% discount to the 200-day cost basis, capital is choosing to flee alts rather than buy the dip. The data makes it clear: this isn't an across-the-board rally driven by new inflows, but a risk-off rotation within existing liquidity. Alts are bleeding out, and risk aversion is at an extreme. How much longer will this divergence last?

comments.title: 🔥估值跌入历史极值区间
comments.body: 市场处于深度筑底阶段。AHR999为0.40处于抄底区，价格较200日成本$88,080倒挂17.2%。MVRV仅1.33，低于历史71%的时间，且持平于2022年5月。核心指标共振显示筹码已极度低估，具备高赔率特征。这是黎明前的至暗时刻吗？
